task.description:
Produce a fix design artefact for ISS-0113 — Event-store idempotency fixtures contaminate shared integration state.

Root cause (from Step 1 diagnosis):
- Integration tests reuse deterministic event_id and idempotency_key values via hardcoded seeds
- Different test binaries sharing the same database collide on these identifiers
- PostgreSQL uq_event_idempotency constraint rejects duplicates (error 23505)
- Cleanup fails due to FK ordering violations

Resolution strategy (three-part fix):
1. Migrate to per-test randomness: Replace generateTestUuid(seed) with TestHarness.newUuid()
2. Harden cleanup ordering: Ensure FK-ordered deletes
3. Enforce via lint: Add T011 rule to flag deterministic-seed patterns

Your task:
Produce a Type E prose design artefact at src/design/iss-0113-fix.md that specifies:
- For each affected test file (from diagnosis report), the exact changes needed:
  - Which generateTestUuid(seed) calls to replace with TestHarness.newUuid()
  - Cleanup ordering changes (if any)
- New helper function signature for TestHarness.newUuid() in tests/integration/helpers.zig
- Lint rule T011 specification for tools/lint_test_isolation.py
- Verification approach (how to confirm the fix works)

The design must NOT contain implementation code — only function signatures, before/after patterns, and pseudocode.

Return PASS with the design artefact in artifacts_out.

REWORK 1:
- [MAJOR] Missing required Interface section. The lint tool requires one of: Public Interface, Interface, or API. Function signatures are scattered across sections 1.2 and 2.3 but must be consolidated in a dedicated interface section.
acceptance_criteria: All affected files from diagnosis have fix specification
No implementation code in the design

result.summary: Design rework 1 completed: Added dedicated Public Interface section consolidating TestHarness.newUuid() and helpers.cleanupInstance() signatures.
